chunks: When you are in the seventh circuit, stand at al-Mustajar—and it is the rear of the Kaaba on the side near the Yemeni Corner, in line with the door of the Kaaba. Then spread your hands on the House, press your cheek and your belly against the House, and say: "O Allah, the House is Your House, the servant is Your servant, and this is the station of one seeking refuge in You from the Fire. O Allah, I have alighted in Your courtyard, so make my hospitality Your forgiveness, and grant me what is between me and You, and seek me as a gift from Your creation."

And supplicate with whatever you wish, then confess your sins to your Lord and say: "O Allah, from You are the spirit, the comfort, the joy, and the well-being. O Allah, my deed is weak, so multiply it for me, and forgive me for what You have seen of me and what is hidden from Your creation. I seek refuge in Allah from the Fire."

And make abundant du'a for yourself, then touch the Yemeni Corner, then touch the corner in which is the Black Stone, kiss it, and conclude with it. If you are not able to do that, it does not harm you, except that it is necessary to begin with the Black Stone and conclude with it, and say: "O Allah, make me content with what You have provided me, and bless for me what You have given me."

key_terms.مَغْفِرَتَكَ: Your forgiveness, asked from Allah as the pilgrim's hospitality.
key_terms.مَقَامُ ٱلْعَائِذِ: The station of one seeking refuge, here from the Fire.
key_terms.ٱلدُّعَاءِ: Supplication, which the pilgrim is instructed to increase for himself.
key_terms.ٱلرُّكْنَ ٱلْيَمَانِيَّ: The Yemeni Corner of the Kaaba, referenced as a point of location and ritual touching.
key_terms.ٱلشَّوْطِ ٱلسَّابِعِ: The seventh circuit of tawaf, at which this act is performed.
key_terms.ٱلنَّارِ: The Fire, from which refuge is sought.
key_terms.ٱلْحَجَرُ ٱلْأَسْوَدُ: The Black Stone, with which tawaf is begun and concluded.
key_terms.ٱلْمُسْتَجَارِ: The place at the rear of the Kaaba near the Yemeni Corner where one stands during tawaf.

ai.seo_question: What should be said and done at al-Mustajar during the seventh circuit of tawaf?
ai.summary: This passage describes the recommended standing at al-Mustajar during the seventh circuit of tawaf, along with the supplications to be recited there. It combines practical ritual instruction with du'a, confession of sins, seeking forgiveness, and seeking refuge from the Fire.
